The next question is to be examined relates to the assessment of the amount of damages/compensation to which the plaintiff is entitled.

As per general principles given by the Apex Courts in various judgments, the compensation should, to the extent possible, fully and adequately restore the claimant in the position prior to the accident.
The object of awarding damages is to make good the loss suffered as a result of wrong done as far as money can do so, in a fair, reasonable and equitable manner.
The Court shall have to assess the damages objectively and exclude from consideration any speculation or fancy.
A person is not only to be compensated for the physical injury but also for the loss which he suffered as a result of such injury.
The heads under which compensation is awarded in personal injury cases are the following:
Pecuniary damages (Special Damages)

(i) Expenses relating to treatment, hospitalization, medicines, transportation,
nourishing food, and miscellaneous expenditure.

(ii) Loss of earnings (and other gains) which the injured would have made had he not been injured, comprising:
(a) Loss of earning during the period of treatment;
(b) Loss of future earnings on account of permanent disability.
(iii) Future
Assessment of pecuniary damages under item (i) and under item (ii-a) do not cause much difficulty as they involve reimbursement of actual and are easily ascertainable from the evidence.
In the present case, from the material on record and testimony of the witnesses, this Court has no hesitation in holding that plaintiff has proved his case.

The plaintiff has been able to prove the medical expenses and loss of earning during the period he was on rest,
therefore, the plaintiff is entitled for expenses of Rs.5 lacs as claimed by him in his plaint relating to treatment, hospitaliz
The plaintiff has proved that he was earning Rs.11,250/- when the accident happened and he got badly injured.
Therefore, he is further entitled for Rs.33,750/- under the head of loss of earning during the period of treatment w.e.f. 21.03.2010 to 21.05.2010 and from 26.05.2010 to 22.06.2010.
A person is not only to be compensated for physical injury but also for loss which he suffered as a result of such injury.
This means that he is to be compensated for his mental trauma.
Hence plaintiff is also entitled for Rs.3,00,000/- as damages for pain, suffering and trauma as a consequences of injuries.
